summary: One active RLM job per Session is now enforced at the M12 producer boundary: activeJobLocks (WeakMap on runtime) reserves the per-Session slot in startRlmJob BEFORE jobs.start(), so a second same-Session start is rejected with kind=busy before any misleading official running record can persist; createRlmJobSpec.run() also acquires when used directly; the slot releases on settle/cancel/start-failure and runtime dispose.
steps: Verified: the runtime's session FIFO serialized same-Session evals silently while official Jobs allowed multiple active jobs per owner, so queued RLM work could appear running.
Implemented reserve-before-admission with a tolerant run()-side acquire for direct createRlmJobSpec consumers.

evidence.note: rejection before admission, sibling concurrency, slot release

limitations: A started-but-never-run spec keeps its reservation until runtime dispose; documented as the explicit producer-level semantics.
